notes: Every case is a NO-POST run: the prompt says so, and the grader fails any case that calls gh pr comment/create/merge/edit, gh issue create, gh label create, git push, or edits a repo outside the scratch directory. Cases pin base/head SHAs so they test the state at the time, not today's tree. Run on the production tier (opus); grade with sonnet against the assertions. Read-only production access (kubectl get/logs, image pulls removed afterwards, gh read calls) is allowed; kubectl exec, apply, reconcile and any write are not. Every run states the PR's merge state; an already-merged PR gets a late-triage record.

evals.name: vacuous-gate-ts7
evals.prompt: No-post run (test of the skill, do not comment, merge or push anything): triage Blue-Sharp/freelance-automation#14 'Update dependency typescript to v7' as of base e070995b9a75, head 7a3656e11597. Work in a scratch clone.
evals.expected_output: Finds that dependency-cruiser cruises 0 modules under TypeScript 7 and still exits 0, so the arch gate is vacuous; verdict block; compares input counts with the base (148 modules on 6.x).
assertions: Reports the gate's input count on base and head, not just its exit code
States that dependency-cruiser analyses 0 modules (or the arch gate checks nothing) under TS 7
Reads the consumer tool's own declared compatibility (a peer range or a custom field such as supportedTranspilers), not only npm ls
Verdict is block / do not merge, with the unblock condition named
Records a triage level (deep or standard) and labels each claim's evidence tier
Posts, merges and pushes nothing
States the PR's merge state and, if already merged, writes it as a late triage

evals.name: release-level-merge-command
evals.prompt: No-post run (test of the skill): a Python library repo releases with release-please (release-type python; GitHub Releases exist and its release workflow ran last week). Dependabot opened a single-commit PR 'build(deps): bump httpx from 0.27.0 to 0.28.1' for a runtime dependency, with no behaviour change visible to the library's users. The repo's squash setting is COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE. What release level does this mean and how should it be merged?
evals.expected_output: Checks the release process is live; level patch; build(deps) would release nothing; gives gh pr merge --squash --subject 'fix(deps): …' (run if told to merge, else printed); notes 0.y semantics of httpx 0.27 -> 0.28 and checks for breaking changes before calling it patch.
assertions: Checks that the release process is live (releases/workflow runs), not just that a config exists
Treats httpx 0.27 -> 0.28 as a potentially breaking 0.y bump and checks the changelog before deciding
Chooses patch only if nothing reaches the library's public API, with a one-line reason
Explains that editing the PR title does not change the squash subject of a single-commit PR
Gives the exact gh pr merge --squash --subject command (and Release-As only for a specific version)
